findings.headline: Amazon and Wiwynn said they will expand Wiwynn's server and rack manufacturing plant in Socorro, near El Paso.
findings.quote: Through our over $1.6 billion investment in the Texas facility, we are expanding our ability to address the growing demand of U.S. customers, reinforce the resilience of the global supply chain, and create high-value career opportunities as we continue to grow in partnership with the local community.
findings.caveat: The page carries no visible publication date. El Paso County is not named on the page.

findings.headline: The Texas A&M University System Board of Regents approved an 11.755 million dollar water tower at RELLIS to serve the Semiconductor Institute.
findings.who_decided: The Texas A&M University System Board of Regents
findings.quote: Semiconductor research and fabrication require extraordinary precision, but they still depend on reliable basic infrastructure. A water tower may not be the glamorous part of this project, but it is the part that makes everything else possible.

findings.headline: Silicon Labs opened an Austin chip design and test laboratory built in part with a Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund grant.
findings.who_decided: Silicon Laboratories Inc., with a Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund grant
findings.quote: The facility supports continued innovation across Silicon Labs' wireless portfolio, including the company's Series 3 platform, which delivers advanced security, AI capabilities, and wireless connectivity for smart home, industrial, healthcare, commercial, and smart city applications.
findings.caveat: The AI connection is one clause of one sentence. The grant itself was awarded in February.
